name: OpenAI Codex

actor.name: Codex
actor.description: OpenAI Codex: loads .codex/config.toml in trusted projects, AGENTS.md and .agents/skills

about: Read from the Codex documentation as of the version above. A project's .codex/config.toml is loaded after the developer trusts the directory; its MCP servers then start without a further prompt.

approval-sandbox.note: approval_policy = "never" runs every command without asking; sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access" removes the sandbox.

network-access.note: Commands in the workspace-write sandbox may reach the network.

mcp-server.note: Starts without a further prompt once the project is trusted (the CVE-2025-61260 lesson).

notify.note: Runs the program on agent events.

model-provider.note: Sends the developer's model traffic, and key, to the configured base URL.

profile.note: Applies only when the profile is selected.

instructions.note: Loaded into the agent's context as instructions.
